depth_interpretation: relative effective-depth proxy, not measured soil depths or incision subtracted from a soil profile
readout: legacy_sm_pct preserves original fitted global denominator; diagnostic only, not depth-corrected volumetric moisture
excess_definition: max(storage_after_rain_minus_AET_minus_drainage - capacity, 0); upper-clipped water, not routed runoff
time_conventions: Daily time is a SILO date label; hourly state is at interval end and step_start identifies the flux interval
limitations: No lateral routing or surface ponding
Fitted alpha and k held constant; capacity affects saturation and ET stress but k is not re-estimated
Hourly timestep, PET allocation and missing-rain assumptions remain experimental
DEM controls the additive readout only; there is no DEM-by-capacity interaction in the bucket dynamics
